steps.en: Officer sees the notices in the selected batch
steps.id: Petugas melihat notice dalam batch yang dipilih
steps.why_en: No screen lists a court application batch.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar yang menampilkan batch court application.

steps.en: Officer adds a notice to the batch
steps.why_en: There is no way to add a notice to a court batch.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada cara menambah notice ke batch court.

steps.en: Officer removes a notice from the batch
steps.why_en: There is no way to remove a notice from a court batch.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada cara menghapus notice dari batch court.

steps.en: Officer edits court number, division and mention time
steps.id: Petugas mengubah nomor court, division, dan waktu mention
steps.why_en: No form or saving exists for these court fields.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada form atau penyimpanan untuk field court ini.

steps.en: The reviewed list and a count summary are shown
steps.id: Daftar hasil review dan ringkasan jumlah ditampilkan
steps.why_en: No review result or summary screen exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar hasil review atau ringkasan.
